description: Read the connector's third-party error logs, or aggregated failure patterns when summary_only is true. Only errors from the third-party system are included, so an empty result means no failures, not no traffic. Known limitation: the time range must not exceed 7 DAYS, and only the last 7 days are retained - start_time defaults to 24 hours ago and end_time to now. Unlike the other list tools this one does return an object: {data: [...], stats: {...}}, with stats present only when include_stats is true.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

end_time.description: End of the range, Unix seconds.

start_time.description: Start of the range, Unix seconds. Must be within the last 7 days.

summary_only.description: Return failure patterns instead of entries.

name: mba_get_connector_logs

outputSchema.description: Log entries or failure patterns, with optional statistics

data.description: Array of log entries or failure patterns depending on query mode

items.description: A log entry (individual mode) or failure pattern (summary_only mode)

error_message.description: Error message from the failed operation

event_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the error event occurred (individual log entry mode)

failure_code_name.description: Human-readable name of the failure code (e.g. TRANSPORT_ERROR)

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent occurrence (summary_only mode)

occurrences.description: Number of times this failure pattern occurred (summary_only mode)

tool_name.description: The tool that was being used when the error occurred

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for the queried time window, present when include_stats is true

start_count.description: Total number of tool execution starts

success_rate.description: Ratio of successful executions to total starts

time_window_seconds.description: Number of seconds in the statistics time window. Reflects the actual covered window, which may be smaller than the requested range if the most recent logs have not yet been processed.

title: Read connector logs
